title: Listening Drill — Borrowed projector
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Borrowed projector
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with a borrowed projector. The main problem is a flicker. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the serial number. Then bring the item to the media desk. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a replacement. don't try to open the casing. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
